# Fix it on IMP-DOC-001..005 runs Claude with Imprimatur's MCP tools, not as a file diff

Those findings live in the database; docs/*.md is generated, so a file diff on it is lost at the next export. Fix it on such a finding (a row, or the bulk button when only docs findings are open) runs a background `claude -p` (sonnet, $3, docs-backfill's tool set plus record_update and task_upsert, no file edits), then re-runs the audit. IMP-DOC-002 alternatives are written only when the task's records show one was weighed.

Alternative: the existing file-diff Fix it on docs/decisions/README.md, rejected because the export overwrites it.
Alternative: an interactive Claude terminal, rejected because the background run already has the tools and the audit re-run closes what it fixed.
Rejected: inventing alternatives for every old decision, because the document would claim options that were never weighed.

Code: vscode/setupView.js fixDocs, vscode/docs-backfill.js fixPrompt, vscode/doc-rules.js decisionGaps. Released in 0.128.0.
